% Adapted from the TeX Live circuitikz manual's current-source and currarrow examples.
\documentclass[varwidth=true,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{circuitikz}

\begin{document}
\begin{circuitikz}[thick]
  \draw (0,0) to[isource, l=$I_E$] ++(2,0);
  \draw (0,-1.5) to[american current source, l=$I_A$] ++(2,0);
  \ctikzset{current arrow scale=8}
  \draw (3,0) to[american current source, l=$I_8$] ++(2,0);
  \ctikzset{current arrow scale=24}
  \draw (3,-1.5) to[dcisource, l=$I_{24}$] ++(2,0);
\end{circuitikz}
\end{document}
